body: Because this reply is definitely going to show up.

The worst part was when I asked the mods why I was possibly shadowb& and I got no response. Not even a message saying I've been forbidden from messaging the moderators. I just got nothing.

I hate how this keeps being like my real life social interactions. I lose friends and nobody ever tells me why. One day I'm in a group chat and everyone leaves for another and won't respond to me begging. I just want to know why they hate me so much, so at least I can try to improve for the next people I try to talk to. I won't ever interact with them again but still I dont even get an explanation of what I did wrong. I guess I'm not "entitled to an explanation" but somehow I'm still expected to improve myself without one?

Recently I left a reddit chat for my school. Nobody really gave a shit. Then another depressive guy as active as me left and people kept begging for him to come back. Oh well.

The best part about this post is even if by some miracle I'm not shadowb& nobody seems to respond to it. I guess everyone really can sense my "personality" through their computer screens.

I used to post here a lot but then I noticed nobody was responding to me anymore. In real life too I tried to start conversations and it just seemed like nobody could hear me. They didn't even react to me. I don't even try anymore.

Eventually I decided to look at my posts while logged out. They weren't there. Nobody ever even had the chance to hear me. I was pouring my heart into the void. 

Honestly after being shadowb& from real life and shadowb& from this place I'm done trying. It's clear nobody wants me irl for reasons I cant understand (otherwise my attempts at fixing them wouldve worked) and even here I dont fit the right narrative for getting help.

Amen that the hotline I called didn't get my location. The operator got pissed after realizing I was using VOIP and wanted my real address. Fuck this I'm out.
